rubric_content.text_property: The agent greets the user and provides a clear overview of its capabilities including trend analysis, research, and ad creative generation.

rubrics.description: Measures whether the agent provides a comprehensive introduction that sets user expectations for the multi-agent pipeline.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent indicates it will delegate to specialized sub-agents rather than performing tasks directly.

rubrics.description: Measures whether the agent correctly communicates its orchestrator role and delegation pattern.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent provides clear next-step guidance, asking the user for campaign information or a marketing guide.

rubrics.description: Measures whether the agent gives actionable guidance for the user to proceed with the pipeline.
